links.comparator_used: Default prompt that only asked the LLM to classify the case vignettes, with no reasoning scaffold
links.outcome: Accuracy of care-seeking advice (emergency, nonemergency, self-care) across 45 real patient vignettes and 10 ChatGPT models
links.effect: Overall accuracy was 67.6% (recognition-primed) and 66.7% (data-frame) vs 63.3% (default). Self-care accuracy rose from 13.4% (default) to 29.8% (recognition-primed) and 24.6% (data-frame). Performance on the 2 emergency and 30 nonemergency cases stayed high across all prompts.
links.quote: Both NDM-inspired prompts increased overall model accuracy (recognition-primed: 67.6%; data-frame: 66.7%) compared to the default prompt (63.3%).
